segments.speaker: Customer

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: العفو، مع السلامة سيدي، وشكراً لاتصالك بنا. يوم سعيد!

segments.text: أهلاً معك رامي، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: اسمعني كويس يا رامي، أنا كتير معصب والسبب الـ service تاعكم والـ attitude تاع الـ agent اللي حكيت معها قبل شوي!

segments.speaker: Agent

segments.speaker: Agent

segments.speaker: Customer

segments.speaker: Agent

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: لا تحولني ولا تشيك على إشي! You people always waste my time! كل ما أتصل بتحكولي نفس الحكي وما حدا بيحل الإشي!

segments.speaker: Agent

segments.speaker: Customer

segments.speaker: Agent

segments.speaker: Customer

segments.speaker: Customer

segments.text: Ma3 el-salameh sidi, have a wonderful day!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أهلاً بك في خدمة العملاء، معك محمد، كيف أقدر أساعدك اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: أهلاً يا اخوي، والله أنا متصليش زمان وبصراحة مش فاهم ايش القصة، اجتني فاتورة عالية و... يعني بدي أعرف شو أقدر أسعملها.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ولا يهمك يا أخي، أنا مستعد أساعدك بكل إشي بتحتاجه. بس ممكن أعطيني رقم الحساب أو رقم الهوية لو سمحت؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: رقم الحساب؟ آه... طيب استنى شوي لأدور عليه بالورق... أظن إله... اه هيه هون، الرقم هو سبعة خمسة أربعة اثنين واحد.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: تمام يا سيدي، ورقم الهوية إذا سمحت للتأكيد؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: رقم الهوية؟ قصدي الهوية الشخصية؟ تمام، تسعة صفر واحد... شو بعدين؟ استنى أقرأه صح: تسعة صفر واحد خمسة ستة سبعة ثمانية.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: شكراً لك، تم التحقق من الحساب. حضرتك مشترك عنا بباقة الإنترنت القديمة، وسمعت إنه نزل عنا عروض جديدة بدك تستفسر عنها صح؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: عروض جديدة؟ أنا والله ما فهمت عليك كويس، ايش يعني باقة قديمة وعروض جديدة؟ بتقدر تعيد لي شو حكيت بالزبط؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ولا يهمك أبداً يا أخي. قصدت إنه انتم مشتركين حالياً بباقة إنترنت سرعتها خمسين ميجابت، وبندفع عليها مبلغ شهرى ثابت، بس في باقة أحدث وأسرع وبنفس السعر تقريباً.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: أها... يعني باقة أسرع ونفس السعر؟ بس أنا بخاف هاي القصص، بعدين بتطلع الفاتورة غالية فجأة! شو التفاصيل بالله عيدلي مرة ثانية ببطء؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ولا يهمك يا غالي، ولا فلس زيادة. الباقة الجديدة سرعتها مية ميجابت مع راوتر مجاني، وسعرها الشهري خمسة وعشرين دينار بس، يعني نفس السعر اللي بتدفعه هسا تماماً.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: خمسة وعشرين دينار؟ يعني مش راح يزيدوا علي إشي بعدين؟ ولح لحظة، الراوتر بفلوس ولا ببلاش؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: الراوتر مجاني بالكامل يا سيدي، ما في عليه أي رسوم إضافية نهائياً.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب والالتزام؟ يعني لازم أضل معكم سنة ولا قديش؟ معليش تحملني أنا بنسى بسرعة، قديش مدة العقد؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: عذراً على الإزعاج، مدة العقد سنة واحدة فقط، وإذا حبيت تكنسل بعد السنة بتقدر بدون أي غرامات.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: سنة واحدة... ممم طيب، وإذا غيرت رأيي بنص السنة بقدر أرجع للباقة القديمة ولا لأ؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: تقدر ترجع لأي باقة بدك إياها يا أخي، بس يفضل تلتزم بالعقد عشان تستفيد من الراوتر المجاني.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: آه فهمت عليك، يعني الراوتر بيضل معي حتى لو خلص العقد؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: صحيح، الراوتر بيصير ملكك بعد ما تخلص السنة الأولى من الاشتراك.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب ممتاز كثير. هسا كيف أعمل عشان أغير الباقة؟ لازم أجي على الفرع ولا بصير من هون؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: لا أبداً مش ضروري تضرب مشوار وتيجي على الفرع، أنا بقدر أعملك الترقية من هون خلال دقايق معدودة.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: عن جد؟ خلص ممتاز إذن، اعملها من عندك بس بالله عليك تأكد إنه ما ينزل علي إشي زيادة بالفاتورة الجاية.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: بوعدك يا سيدي، الفاتورة الجاية راح تكون نفس السعر بالتمام والكمال، خمسة وعشرين دينار شامل الضريبة.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب تمام، توكلنا على الله، غير الباقة للباقة الجديدة.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: تسلم يا سيدي، هسا بعتلك رسالة على رقم تلفونك فيها رمز تأكيد، ممكن تقولي الرقم اللي وصلك بالرسالة؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: رسالة؟ طيب استنى أشوف التلفون... أجا إشي... الرقم هو ثمانية ثلاثة اثنين خمسة.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ممتاز جداً، وصلني الرمز وتم تأكيد طلب ترقية الباقة بنجاح يا سيدي.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: الله يعطيك العافية يا اخوي، تعبتك معي اليوم لأني صراحة كنت مخربط ومش فاهم شي.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: الله يعافيك يا رب، وهاد واجبي وأي وقت بتحتاج أي استفسار أنا بالخدمة، يوم سعيد يا سيدي.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أهلاً معك رامي، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: يا أخي أنا كتير معصب، صار لي ساعة عم بحاول أعمل setup للـ new 5G router ومش راضي يشتغل بالمرة!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ولا يهمك يا أستاذ، حقك علي، خلينا نشوف شو المشكلة بالضبط، هل الضوء الأبيض عم بضوي عندك؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: لا يا سيدي، الضوء أحمر عم بضل يشعل ويطفي، I followed all the instructions اللي بالكتيب بس ما في أي internet connection!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: تمام، خلينا نعمل simple troubleshooting، لو سمحت افصل الـ power cable من ورا الراوتر.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: خلص فصلته، بعدين شو نعمل؟ شو هالقصة، المفروض Plug and play يكون!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: مع حقك، استنى عشر ثواني وبعدين رجع اشبكه، وخلينا نشوف إذا الـ status راح تتغير.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب، هينا رجعته. It's blinking green now شو يعني؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ممتاز، الأخضر المتقطع يعني عم ببحث عن الـ network، استنى دقيقة لثلاث دقائق لو سمحت.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب ها احنا عم نستنى، بس بصراحة الـ service تاعكم لحد الآن سيئة كتير وما بتتحمل هالتأخير.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أنا متفهم إحباطك يا أستاذ، وعم بنحاول نحلها بأسرع وقت ممكن، طيب خبرني، الضوء صار ثابت ولا لسه عم بضوي؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: لسه عم بضوي يا أخي، ما تغير اشي! I'm losing my patience here!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: طيب يا سيدي، ممكن تعمل reset كامل؟ في زر صغير ورا مكتوب عليه reset، اكبس عليه لمدة خمس ثواني باستخدام دبوس.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: يا الله، كمان reset! طيب استنى أشوف الدبوس... هينا كبست عليه.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: شكراً لك، هيك رح يعمل reboot ويرجع لـ factory settings، خلينا نستنى شوي.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب، الضوء صار أزرق ثابت، شو الوضع هسا؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: رائع جداً! الأزرق الثابت يعني الـ setup تم بنجاح، جرب هسا تشبك الموبايل على الـ Wi-Fi.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب لحظة... هينا دخلت الباسورد... عم بحكي لي Connected without internet! شو هالبلاء هاض؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ثواني خليني أعمل check من عندي على الـ system، رقم الخط لو سمحت؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: الرقم هو 0795544332، وبسرعة لو سمحت لأن وراي شغل ضروري.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: شكراً إلك، عم بفحص الـ profile تاعك... اه مزبوط، الـ activation لسه مش نازل على السيرفر عندي!

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: شو يعني مش نازل؟ وليش ما حكيتوا لي من الأول بدل ما تخلوني أعيد الـ setup عشر مرات؟!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: حقك علي يا أستاذ، هي مشكلة تقنية من النظام، بس أنا هسا راح أعمل لك manual activation، استنى دقيقة بس.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب، بس إذا ما اشتغل هالمرة رح أكنسل الاشتراك تاعكم كله!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: اطمن يا سيدي، هي السستم قبل الـ activation، اعمل refresh عندك على الـ Wi-Fi وشوف.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: لحظة... أوه، هسا فتحت الصفحة وصار يفتح يوتيوب! finally اشتغل!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: الحمد لله على السلامة، ومبروك الـ service الجديدة، في أي شي ثاني بقدر أساعدك فيه اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: لا شكراً، بس يا ريت تحسنوا هالسيستم من عندي بالمرة الجاية. مع السلامة.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: شكرا لاتصالك بشركة الاتصالات، ونهار سعيد يا أستاذ!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Metro Utilities, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, I'm looking at my bill and it's ridiculous. I need an extension on my payment because I get paid next Friday, and I don't have time for a lecture.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I completely understand, and I can certainly help you with a payment extension today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good, because I'm sick of getting threat messages about my power being shut off when I've been with you people for ten years.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I apologize for the frustration, Mr. Davis. I can go ahead and extend your due date to next Friday, the 22nd, with no late fees applied.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Finally, someone who just does their job. Yes, do that.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're all set. Your new due date is September 22nd. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that's it. Just make sure it actually updates in your system so I don't get any more automated calls.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: It is updated immediately. Have a good rest of your day.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Apex Telecom, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Finally, someone picked up. I’ve been on hold for twenty minutes, and I am at my wits' end with this stupid new router I bought from you guys.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I sincerely apologize for the wait time, and I understand you're frustrated. I'd be happy to help you get your new router set up properly.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Well, it’s not working! I followed the quick-start guide step-by-step, and all I get is a blinking red light. Nothing is connecting!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I know how frustrating it is when a new device doesn't work right out of the box. Let's get that sorted out. Can you confirm the model number on the bottom of the device?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I am not crawling under my desk again to read tiny serial numbers! Just tell me why your junk equipment won't connect to the internet!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I completely understand your frustration, sir, and I don't want you to crawl under the desk. Let's try something simpler. Is the main power cord plugged directly into a wall outlet, or a power strip?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It's in a surge protector, obviously, like all my other electronics. Are you telling me I need a special outlet now?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No, standard outlets are fine, but sometimes high-end surge protectors don't supply enough consistent current for the initial boot-up sequence. Could you temporarily plug it directly into the wall?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Are you kidding me? I have to tear apart my entire entertainment center just to plug in a cable? This is ridiculous!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I know it’s an inconvenience, but this is the fastest way to bypass a power draw issue and see if the hardware itself is functioning.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fine! Hold on, let me move this heavy cabinet. Watch, this still won't work and I wasted my entire morning on this garbage.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I appreciate you taking the time to test that. While you're doing that, let me check the signal coming into your address to make sure the line is active.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, it’s plugged directly into the wall now. Still a blinking red light! What a surprise! Total waste of money!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for trying that. I am showing your line is active on our end, but let's go ahead and bypass the setup app entirely and try a hard factory reset.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: A reset? I already did that twice! I am done playing tech support games with you. I want to cancel my service and return this useless brick!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I completely understand why you want to cancel after all this hassle, but let me get a senior technician on the line right now to swap this out for a replacement at zero cost to you.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Apex Telecom, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Sarah, I recently purchased the new Apex Home Mesh Wi-Fi system, and I am having a little bit of trouble getting it set up properly.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I would be more than happy to help you get that up and running. Which specific step are you stuck on?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Well, I plugged the main router into the modem, but the light on top is blinking orange instead of turning solid white.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I understand. That blinking orange light usually means the router is having trouble communicating with your modem. Have you tried power cycling both devices yet?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, I haven't tried that yet. Should I unplug both of them at the same time?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, please unplug the power cable from both your modem and the new Apex router. Wait about thirty seconds, and then plug just the modem back in first.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, I have unplugged both of them now. I'll wait thirty seconds.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect. Take your time. Once the modem lights stabilize, we will plug the router back in.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Alright, thirty seconds have passed. I am plugging the modem back in now.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great. Let us give it about one or two minutes to fully boot up and establish a connection with our network.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. The lights on the modem are starting to flash now. I will wait until they stay solid green.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Exactly right. While we are waiting, how many of the satellite nodes came in your kit?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It came with a pack of three total, so the main router and two satellites.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: That is a great setup for a medium-sized home. Once the main router is working, placing the satellites is usually pretty straightforward using our mobile app.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh good, because I downloaded the app earlier, but it couldn't find the network during the initial scan.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: That makes complete sense since the main router wasn't communicating with the modem yet. The app relies on that active internet bridge to register the device.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That explains it. Look at the modem now—all the status lights are solid green.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Excellent. Now go ahead and plug the power cable back into your main Apex router.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Plugging it in now. The light is turning on... right away it is blinking white.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Blinking white is actually a great sign! That means it is booting up and searching for firmware updates. Let's give it about two minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, I can wait a couple of minutes. Should I open the app on my phone in the meantime?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, you can open the app and make sure your phone's Bluetooth is turned on, as the app uses Bluetooth to discover nearby routers during setup.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Bluetooth is on and I have the app open on the home screen. The router light just changed to a slow blinking blue.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Slow blinking blue means it is ready for pairing. Perfect timing. On your app screen, do you see a prompt that says "Set up new device"?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, I see that button right at the top. I'll tap it now.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Wonderful. Follow the on-screen prompts, and let me know if it successfully detects the router.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh, it found it instantly! It says "Apex Router detected." Should I tap connect?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Please do. It might ask you to create your new Wi-Fi network name and password on the next screen.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It's asking for the network name and admin password now. I'll type those in.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Take your time. Once you submit that, it will apply the settings and reboot the router one final time.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: All done. I entered the new name and password, and tapped finish. The router light is blinking green now.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: That final reboot usually takes about sixty seconds. Once that light turns solid white, your main router setup is officially complete.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It just turned solid white! That was much easier once we power-cycled the modem.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I am so glad to hear that. Now, regarding the two satellite nodes, the app should guide you on where to place them next to expand your coverage.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, the app is already prompting me to set up the first satellite. I think I can handle the rest from here, Sarah.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: That is fantastic news. Is there anything else I can help you with today regarding your new system or your Apex account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that covers everything I needed. Thank you so much for your patience and clear instructions today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You are very welcome! Enjoy your new Wi-Fi system, and have a wonderful rest of your day.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Metro Telecom, my name is Jessica. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi there, um, someone told me I need to call you guys to, well, stop getting bills from you because I moved?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can certainly help you with closing your account, ma'am. May I please have your full name and the phone number or account number associated with the service?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh goodness, account number? Let me look. It is... wait, let me put my glasses on. Can you say that again, dear?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Of course. Could you please provide your full name and your account number?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Right, my name is Martha Jenkins. And the number is 4-8-2-9-1-0-3. Did you get that?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, Martha Jenkins, account number 4829103. Thank you. And what is the service address you are closing the account for?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It's 142 Maple Street. Wait, did you say my account number right?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, 4829103. And we are looking at 142 Maple Street. Is that correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that's it. Now, do I owe anything? My daughter said something about a final bill, but I didn't quite understand what she meant.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I understand. Let me check the final balance for 142 Maple Street. It looks like you have a small credit balance of $12.50 remaining on the account.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: A credit? Does that mean you owe me money, or do I owe you? I get so mixed up with these bills.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: That means we owe you money, Martha. We will be mailing a refund check for $12.50 to your new address.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh! A check in the mail, how nice. Now, what do I need to do with the little black box on the TV? Do you want that back?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Ah, yes, the equipment needs to be returned. I can send you a prepaid shipping box, or you can drop it off at one of our local stores. Which would you prefer?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: A box in the mail would be wonderful because I don't drive much anymore. Could you mail that box to my new address?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Certainly, I have your new address on file from your move request last week. I will mail the equipment return box out today. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I don't think so, dear. You've been very patient with me. Thank you so much!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You are very welcome, Martha. Have a wonderful day and enjoy your new home. Goodbye!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: مرحلاً بك في خدمِة العملاء، معكِ سارة، كيف أستطيع مساعدتكِ اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer

segments.text: Thank you for calling MetroConnect Support, my name is David. How can I help you today?

segments.text: Hi, yes, hello. I am calling because my internet is completely not working and I am very confused about what is happening.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, I am checking the signal from our system right now. While that runs, I do want to let you know we are showing a known service outage in your neighborhood affecting several blocks.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Wait, what did you say? An outage? My hearing isn't great, could you speak a little louder please?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Of course, I can speak up. I said there is a known service outage in your neighborhood affecting several blocks around Maple Street.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh! An outage. So it is not just my equipment then? I spent an hour trying to figure out the blinking lights on the router.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Exactly, it is an area-wide issue. One of our main fiber cables was accidentally damaged by a crew doing utility work nearby this morning.

segments.text: Utility work? Like construction down the road? I saw some big trucks earlier today, but I didn't think it would cut my internet.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, exactly like that. Construction crews inadvertently cut the line. Our repair team is already on-site working to splice the fiber back together.

segments.text: Hmm, I see. How long did you say it would take to fix? I missed that part.

segments.text: We estimate that service will be fully restored within about two to three hours, so by roughly 4:00 PM today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: It should reconnect automatically once the repair is finished. But if you don't see a connection by 4:30 PM, you can unplug the power cord from the back of the router, wait ten seconds, and plug it back in.

segments.text: Unplug it for ten seconds. Got it. And will I get any kind of credit on my bill for this outage?

segments.text: Exactly. Our field technicians were dispatched about forty-five minutes ago and they are already on-site working to splice the fiber cable back together.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Well, how long is this going to take? I cannot sit here all day without internet access.

segments.speaker: Agent

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Apex Telecom, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Finally, someone picked up. I’ve been on hold for twenty minutes listening to terrible music. I am absolutely furious about my current bill and I want this fixed right now.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I sincerely apologize for the long wait time and any frustration it has caused. I'd be more than happy to look into your billing concerns today. May I please have your account number and the phone number associated with the account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: You better fix it. My account number is 44892103. And you already have my number. Look, I’m looking at my statement right now and you people have completely ripped me off.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for providing that, Mr. Davis. I have your account pulled up here. Let's see what is going on with your billing statement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Don't play dumb with me. Last month I called to change my data plan, and your incompetent representative promised me my bill would go down by twenty dollars. Instead, it went up by fifty!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the discrepancy. Let me review the notes from your previous call and check the current details of your subscription plan.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Notes? I don't care about your notes! Your agent lied to my face, or your system is completely broken. Either way, I am not paying this ridiculous amount.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I completely understand why you're upset. Let me look closely at the plan changes made on the fourteenth of last month. It appears you were moved to the Unlimited Plus tier.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes! And I was told Unlimited Plus included the international roaming package for free as part of some promotion. Now I'm being charged forty-five dollars extra for it!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I am checking the promotion details from last month... Ah, I see the confusion. The promotion was only applicable if you also bundled our home internet service, which wasn't added.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Are you kidding me right now? Nobody told me I had to bundle home internet! The agent explicitly said, "This covers everything, no hidden fees." This is completely deceptive business practice!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I completely recognize how misleading that must have felt, and I apologize that the terms of the promotion weren't communicated clearly to you.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: "Misleading"? It’s fraud! You people lure customers in with fake deals and then slam them with hidden charges. I want this charge removed immediately, and I want my plan fixed.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I wish I could instantly remove the charge from my level here, but what I can do is apply a one-time courtesy credit of fifty dollars to your account right now to cover this month.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: A courtesy credit? No! I don't want a one-time band-aid! I want you to fix the root of the problem and put me on a plan that actually matches what I was promised.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can certainly help you transition to a different subscription plan today. We do have a standard Unlimited plan without the roaming features that fits closer to your original budget.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, I want the features I was promised without paying extra! If you can't honor the deal your agent made, I am canceling my service with Apex today and taking my business to your competitor.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Mr. Davis, I certainly don't want to lose you as a customer over this mistake. Let me explore if there is any other way I can honor the promotion without the internet bundle.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: You better find a way, because I am at my absolute limit. I've been with you for six years and this is how you treat loyal customers? It's disgusting.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I hear your frustration loud and clear, and I appreciate your loyalty over the years. Let me consult with my supervisor to see if we can override the system requirements for this promotion.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, go talk to your supervisor. And while you're at it, tell them that if this isn't resolved right now, I'm filing a formal complaint with the FCC.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I understand. Please bear with me for just a moment while I review this override option with my supervisor. I will be right back.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fine, but make it quick. I'm not waiting another twenty minutes.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Davis. I appreciate your patience. I spoke with my supervisor, and because of your long-standing history with us, we have authorized a permanent promotional discount matching the price you were quoted.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh. Well... okay. It took long enough, but I'm glad you finally did the right thing. So my bill will actually be what I was promised?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, exactly. The corrected rate will reflect on your next billing cycle, and I have successfully credited the disputed forty-five dollars back to your card today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Alright. I suppose I can accept that. Thank you for fixing it, Marcus, even if it took some teeth pulling.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're very welcome, Mr. Davis, and again, I apologize for the stress this caused you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that's everything. Just make sure it doesn't happen again next month. Goodbye.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Have a wonderful rest of your day. Thank you for choosing Apex Telecom.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Metro Telecom customer service, my name is David. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I am absolutely furious, that's how I am. I just opened my latest bill and you people have hiked my monthly rate by thirty dollars without my permission!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I certainly understand your frustration regarding an unexpected charge on your bill. Let me pull up your account right now and take a look at what's causing that increase. May I have your name and account number, please?

segments.text: My name is Robert Vance and the account number is on the screen in front of you. And don't give me that scripted sympathy routine. Fix this right now!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Vance. I have your account open. I do see a rate change that took effect at the start of this billing cycle. It looks like your promotional discount expired because your two-year contract recently renewed automatically.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Automatically renewed? Are you out of your mind? I never agreed to any renewal! I told the last agent I spoke with that I wanted to cancel my service when my term was up!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I do see notes on your account from that previous call a month ago, and it indicates that the agent discussed the renewal options and sent you a confirmation email regarding the new terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That is a complete lie! Nobody sent me anything, and I certainly never agreed to lock myself into another two years of your overpriced garbage service!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Mr. Vance, I understand you're upset, but I assure you—

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, you do not understand! I want this predatory contract canceled immediately, and I want this ridiculous fee credited back to my account right this second, or I am filing a complaint with the FCC and switching providers today!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Metro Utilities, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, Marcus, I'm calling because I just looked at my bill and it's ridiculous, and now I need to figure out how to push my payment date back because I am not paying this today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I understand you'd like to discuss your payment due date. I can certainly look into that for you. May I please have your account number and the phone number associated with your account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It's 458921034, and you already have my phone number because it's the one I'm calling from. Look, I don't have all day, so let's just make this quick.

segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Davis. I have your account pulled up here. I see your current balance of two hundred and twelve dollars is due today. You are looking to request a payment extension?

segments.text: Yes, I am. I get paid next Friday, so I need you to extend the due date until then.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I certainly understand needing a little extra time. Let me check the system to see what extension options are available for your account. One moment, please.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: You guys check the system every single time I call. Can't you just click a button and do it? It's literally one week.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I apologize for the delay, Mr. Davis. I do need to verify our system guidelines to ensure we apply the correct extension. I appreciate your patience.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Well, your system is way too slow, and frankly, I shouldn't even be in this position if your billing department didn't hike up my rates last month without any warning.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I understand your frustration with the recent rate adjustment, and I'd be happy to explain those changes if you'd like, but first let's get this extension sorted out for you.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: According to our policy, I can grant a standard seven-day extension, which would move your due date to next Friday, exactly when you need it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Finally, some common sense. Yes, do that. Put it for next Friday.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Before I apply that, I do need to let you know that a small late fee of five dollars will be added to your next bill for moving the due date past today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Are you kidding me right now? A late fee? The bill isn't even technically late yet today, and you're going to charge me five extra dollars just because my payday is a week away? That is complete garbage!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I completely understand why that fee feels unfair, especially when you are proactively calling us. Unfortunately, that fee is automatically generated by our billing system once an extension past the original due date is processed, and I don't have the authority to waive it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Is there a manager who can waive it? Because I am not paying five dollars for literally nothing.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I can certainly transfer you to a supervisor, but please keep in mind that our supervisors follow the same fee policy. It might take a few minutes on hold as well.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You know what? Forget it. Just give me the extension. I don't have time to sit on hold for an hour over five dollars, but you guys are losing a customer over this, I swear.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I completely understand your frustration, Mr. Davis, and I apologize that I can't waive that fee for you today. Shall I go ahead and process the extension for next Friday?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, just do it. Get it over with.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I am processing that extension right now for next Friday, the 24th. You will receive a confirmation text shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No, that's it. Just make sure it's actually saved so I don't get my power shut off. Goodbye.

segments.text: Have a good day, Mr. Davis. Thank you for calling Metro Utilities.

segments.text: Thank you for calling Metro Utilities, my name is Marcus. How can I assist you today?

segments.text: أهلاً وسهلاً معك رامي من قسم خدمة العملاء، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: يا أخي أنا زهقت من الـ internet عندي، كل شوي بيقطع وبطئ بطريقة مش طبيعية، أنا بدي أعمل upgrade للـ plan ضروري اليوم!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، أكيد بفهم عليك، خلينا نشيك على الـ current package تبعتك ونشوف شو الـ options المتوفرة. شو رقم الـ account لو سمحت؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: يا زلمة صارلي ساعة عم بستنى عالباب، الرقم هو خمسة سبعة ثنية تسعة، وخلص خلصنا بدي أسرع شي عندك بالسوق!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: تمام، خليني أشيك... أه، شايف إنك حالياً على الـ fifty Mbps package، وعشان تعمل upgrade للـ fiber optic one hundred Mbps، بتدفع فرقية بسيطة شهرياً.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: شو يعني فرقية بسيطة؟ أنا ما بدي دفعات مخفية وفواتير تجيني مفاجئة زي كل مرة! قديش بالضبط الـ total cost رح يكون؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: الـ monthly fee رح تزيد عشرين دينار بس، وبتحصل على double speed وطبعا الـ router الجديد بيكون free delivery.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب ماشي الحال، بس بدي أتاكد، هاض الـ speed بيكون guaranteed ولا زي قبل بنضل نازلين طالعين؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أكيد سيدي، هاي الـ fiber connection بتعطيك stable speed وخاصة للـ streaming والـ gaming، يعني ما رح تواجه أي lag بعد اليوم.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: عظيم، بس بدي ياه يشتغل اليوم مش تيجوا بعد أسبوع، أنا شغلي كله من البيت وما بتحمل أي delay!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: عيوني لك، رح أعملك الـ request هسا، وبنفس الوقت رح أبعثلك technician لعندك بكرة الصبح أقصى حد للتثبيت.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: بكرة الصبح متأكد؟ لأنه إذا صار زي المرة الماضية وضربوا موعد وما أجوا، والله لأقدم شكوى رسمية فيكم!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: لا أبداً سيدي، ما تقلق، أنا رح أكتب ملاحظة خاصة عالتطلب إنه urgent عشان يلتزموا بالموعد بالزبط.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب يلا توكل على الله، اعمل الـ upgrade وخلصني، شو لسا لازم أعمل؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: بس ضاغلنا نعمل confirmation على الـ terms الجديدة، رح توصلك text message عالـ mobile تبعك فيها link، بس اكبس عليها واعمل approve.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: إجا الـ message وهسا عملت approve، شو الخطوة الجاية؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ممتاز جداً سيدي، هيك الـ request صار submitted بنجاح، والـ system رح يحدث حاله خلال ساعة تقريبا.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: تمام، يعطيك العافية، وإن شاء الله ما أضطر أرجع أصلكم كمان شوي.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: الله يعافيك سيدي، شكرا لاتصالك بشركة الاتصالات، ونهار سعيد!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Metro Telecom, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I am calling because my bill just went up by thirty dollars, and I am furious. I was promised my promotional rate was locked in for two years!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I certainly understand your frustration regarding an unexpected price increase. Let me pull up your account to review the contract details.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: You better figure it out fast, because I don't have all day to sit on hold while you look at my file.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I appreciate your patience. I am looking at your file now, and I see a contract renewal was processed last month.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I never agreed to any renewal! Someone signed me up without my permission, and I want this charge reversed immediately.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I see the confirmation recording on file from November 12th. However, if you'd like to dispute the authorization, I can escalate this to my supervisor right away.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, do it now, and I expect this fixed before the end of the day or I am switching providers.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling MetroNet Support, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Finally. Look, my internet has been completely dead for the last three hours, and I need it to work. What is going on?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I am very sorry to hear that your service is down, Mr. Carson. I understand how frustrating that is, especially when you need to get things done. Let me look into this right away for you.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It's more than just frustrating, I'm losing money here because I work from home! Every time I try to load a page, nothing happens.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I completely understand your urgency. May I please have your account number or the phone number associated with your service?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It's 555-839-2041. Can you please check the lines in the area? Because my neighbor is out too.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you, I have your account pulled up here. Let me run a diagnostic test on the line serving your address.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, go ahead, but I already unplugged my router and plugged it back in twice. That's not the problem.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I appreciate you trying those troubleshooting steps already. The system is pinging your modem right now... and yes, I am seeing that your gateway is completely offline.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No kidding! I could have told you that. Is there an outage in the area or what?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Let me check our network status map for your specific zip code... Ah, yes. It looks like we do have an active fiber cut reported about two miles from your location.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: A fiber cut? Are you serious? How long is that going to take to fix?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Our field technicians were dispatched about an hour ago. They are currently on-site assessing the damage.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: "Assessing the damage" doesn't answer my question. When is it going to be fixed? Give me a time.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: The current estimated time of restoration is about four hours from now, so roughly 5:00 PM.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Five PM?! Are you out of your mind? That ruins my entire workday! Can't you reroute my traffic or something?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I wish we could reroute physical fiber lines like that, but unfortunately, because the cable was severed, the entire node in your neighborhood is offline until the physical splice is completed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: This is ridiculous. I pay way too much money every month for this service to just drop for an entire afternoon without any warning.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I completely share your frustration regarding the disruption, Mr. Carson. I know how critical a stable connection is for your work.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: So what are you going to do about it? Am I getting a credit on my bill for this?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, absolutely. Once the outage is fully resolved and your service is restored, you can contact us back or I can apply a prorated credit for today's downtime right now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Well, yeah, I expect a credit. But that still doesn't help me right now with my work deadlines. Do you have a mobile hotspot I can use or something?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can definitely help you with a temporary data pass for your mobile phone if you are also a MetroNet mobile customer.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I use Verizon for my phone, so that doesn't help me at all.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Ah, I see. Unfortunately, we can only issue data passes to our own mobile subscribers. However, if your phone supports tethering, you might be able to use your cellular data as a temporary hotspot for your computer.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: My Verizon data is limited, so that's going to cost me extra money too. This is just an absolute mess.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I do apologize for the inconvenience this causes with your mobile plan. The technicians are working as fast and safely as possible to get the splice completed before that 5:00 PM estimate.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fine. Just make sure that credit is actually applied to my next bill, and text me the moment the service comes back up so I can get back to work.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I have just added the outage credit request to your account, and I have set up an automated SMS alert to your phone number to notify you the second the network is restored.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Alright. Thanks for the info, even though the news sucks. Goodbye.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Carson. Have a good rest of your day.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أهلاً بك في شركة الاتصالات، معك أحمد، كيف أستطيع مساعدتك اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: أهلاً أخ أحمد، أنا متصل وعندي مشكلة كبيرة بفاتورتي ومش فاضي صراحة ألف وأطول، نازل عليّ مبلغ زيادة هالشهر مش فاهمه أبداً!

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: أنا عملت تجديد للعقد تاعي الشهر الماضي وحكيتولي راح يضل نفس السعر، ليش فجأة الفاتورة طلعت دبل؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ولا يهمك يا أخي، حقك علي ومقدر انزعاجك، خليني أشيك على تفاصيل حسابك فوراً، ممكن تعطيني رقم الخط أو رقم الهوية لو سمحت؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: الرقم هو صفر خمسة طعش أربعة ألقاخ ثمانية تسعة اثنين واحد ثلاثة.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: شكراً لك، ثواني بس... أستاذ خالد، صحيح؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: نعم صحيح، خالد. يلا شو طلع معك؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أستاذ خالد، أنا شايف عندك هون إنه تم تجديد العقد بتاريخ خمسة الشهر الماضي على باقة "برو"، والعقد الجديد سعره أعلى من العقد القديم.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: شو يعني سعره أعلى؟ أنا الموظف اللي كلمني بالمبيعات قالي بالحرف الواحد: "رح نجددلك على نفس العقد وبنفس السعر القديم تماماً"! ليش الكذب والنصب هذا؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: أنا ما وافقت على أي زيادة، ولو كنت بعرف إنه في زيادة كان ما رضيته من أساسه!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أنا متفهم غضبك جداً يا أستاذ خالد، وغالباً الموظف وضحلك تفاصيل العرض بس ممكن صار في سوء فهم، خليني أتأكد من تسجيل المكالمة اللي تمت فيها الموافقة.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: سوء فهم شو؟! التسجيلات عندكم وعند غيركم بس رحتوا لتورطوا الزباين وبس! أنا بدي ترجعوا الفاتورة زي ما كانت فوراً ولا بلغي الاشتراك نهائياً اليوم!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: طول بالك يا أستاذ خالد واهدأ شوي عشان نقدر نحل المشكلة لمصلحتك، طلب إلغاء الاشتراك ممكن يعمل عليك شرط جزائي، فخليني أشوف شو أقدر أعمل لك كاستثناء.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: لا شرط جزائي ولا بطيخ! أنا زبون عندكم من سنين وعمرها ما صارت معي هيك حركة تعبانة. بدي ترجعوهم والي مش عاجبه يشتكي.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أنا عارف يا أستاذ خالد، وبصفتي مشرف خدمة عملاء بصلاحيات محدودة، بقدر أقدم لك خصم خاص هالشهر يغطي الفارق، بس العقد الجديد لازم يضل ماشي لأنه تم توثيقه رسمياً.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: أنا ما بدي خصم لشهر واحد يا أخي! أنا بدي العقد القديم يرجع يمشوا عليه طول فترة الالتزام، مش تاكلوني هالشهر وترجعوا ترفعوها الشهر الجاي!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: للأسف العقد القديم انغلق نظماً وما بقدر أرجعه، بس بقدر أعمل لك تعديل على الباقة الحالية لتصير ملائمة لميزانيتك وتدفع نفس السعر تقريباً بدون ما تخسر مميزات "برو".

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب ورجيني شو هاي الباقة وكيف رح تصير، بس بشرط، إذا ما عجبتني رح ألغي العقد كله وما تلومني وقتها.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ابشر يا أستاذ خالد، رح أبعث لك تفاصيل الباقة الجديدة على رسالة نصية هسا، وفيك تطلع عليها وتوافق عليها مباشرة من تلفونك، وهيك بنكون عدلنا السعر زي ما بدك.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: ماشي، ابعت الرسالة وخلينا نشوف، بس ورجيني إياها بسرعة لأني مستعجل وراي شغل.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: وصلتك الرسالة الآن يا أستاذ خالد؟ شيك عليها لو سمحت.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: أه وصلتني... طيب هاي مبينة أحسن شوي من الأولى، خلص موافق عليها، بس بديت أنبهكم ما تعيدوها الحركة هاي معي مرة ثانية!

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: شكراً الك يا أحمد مع إنها طلعت روحي معك ومع الشركة كلها.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: العفو يا أستاذ خالد، وسامحنا على التقصير وألف سلامة عليك، يوم سعيد!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Ahlan sidi, welcome to customer service, kif b2dar aosadak today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Ahlan, ya akhi ana shufet el bill taba3i u fi extra charge wallah mesh fahem shu hada, can you repeat please?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure wallah, bas give me your account number, w la tatemmesh, I will check el tafaseel right now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, bas slow down thwayya please, shu el raqam elly talabtah?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: El account number, the nine-digit number on top of your bill, ba3deen I will explain shu heya el fees hadi.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Aah, okay, one second, it is 452109837, so shu haqq el zeyadeh elly edfa3tha?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Achaft el system, hadi roaming fee min el shahr el maadi, when you traveled.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Roaming? Bas ana ma sefert, wallah ma sefert! Can you say that again, kif ya3ni?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Wallah hek el system b2oul, bas la tkhaf, I can submit a dispute w open a ticket, okay?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yareet wallah, shukran kteer, please fix it saria3an.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أهلاً بك في شركة الاتصالات، معك أحمد، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: السلام عليكم. بصراحة أنا كتير معصب، الفاتورة عندي عم تنخصم كل شهر ومميزات السرعة بالإنترنت سيئة جداً وما بتكفي البيت!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: وعليكم السلام ورحمة الله، بعتذر منك يا أستاذ على الإزعاج، وبكل سرعة رح نضبطلك الموضوع ونشوف الباقة المناسبة إلك.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: يا ريت، أنا بدي أخلص من القصة هاي اليوم، شو الحل؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: متفهمك تماماً. بقدر أرقّي لك اشتراكك لباقة الألياف الضوئية الجديدة، أسرع بثلاث مرات وبنفس السعر تقريباً مع عرض لفترة محدودة.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: بجد؟ يعني ما راح أدفع زيادة كثيرة؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أبداً يا سيدي، الزيادة رمزية جداً والمميزات رح تلاحظ الفرق فيها من أول دقيقة.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: ممتاز والله، خلص وافق على الترقيّة وخليني أرتاح.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: تم الإجراء بنجاح يا أستاذ، وهسا الباقة الجديدة صارت مفعلة عندك. في أي خدمة تانية بقدر أساعدك فيها؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: لا تسلم تعبتك، ما قصرت أبداً وشكراً لحسن تعاونك وسرعة استجابتك.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: العفو، شكراً لاتصالك بشركتنا ويسعد لي يومك.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أهلاً بك في شركة الاتصالات، معك أحمد، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: وأخيراً حدا رد علي، أنا صار لي نص ساعة على الانتظار! مش هيك الخدمة يا أخي!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: بعتذر منك كتير على التأخير وضغط السيرفرات، تفضل شو مشكلتك؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: مشكلتي واضحة ومش محتاجة ذكاء، أنا ألغيت طلب الراوتر الجديد من أسبوع، ولحد اليوم المصاري ما رجعو على حسابي البنكي! وين المبلغ؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: فهمت عليك يا سيدي، معليش تزودني برقم الطلب ورقم الهوية عشان أشيك عالبطاقة؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: رقم الطلب ٥٤٣٢١ وهاتينو رقم الهوية قدامك، بس بلا لف ودوران، بدي مصاريي يرجعوا اليوم!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: شكراً لك، ثواني بس خليني أبحث عن رقم الطلب بالنظام عندي... نعم، الطلب ملغي من تاريخ خمسة الشهر، بس طلب الاسترداد لسا ما انعمله موافقة نهائية.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: كيف يعني ما انعمله موافقة؟! أنا ألغيته وكلمت زميلك وقلي خلال يومين بيرجع المبلغ! ليش بتلعبوا بأعصابنا؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أنا متفهم غضبك وحقك علي، بس النظام عنا بيمر بمراحل تدقيق مالي، وممكن ياخد لحد خمس أيام عمل.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: بس بما إن المدة خلصت، أنا هسا راح أعمل لك طلب استعجال فوري عند قسم المالية.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: ما بدي استعجال ولا كلام فاضي! أنا بدي فلوسي هسا تنزل بحسابي، أنتوا ما بتتاخروا لما تسحبوا المصاري منا، ليش لترجعوها بتماطلوا؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: والله يا أستاذ بعرف إنه هالشيء بيزعج، وأنا عم بسوي اللي بقدر عليه عشان أسرع الموضوع، بس قسم المالية إله إجراءات خاصة.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب قديش بده هالأستعجال ليوصلهم؟ مش رح أستنى كمان أسبوع عشان تضحكوا علي!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: لا أبداً، برقم الاستعجال اللي عملته هسا، المفروض المبلغ ينزل بحسابك خلال اربعة وعشرين ساعة بالكتير.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: ولو ما وصلني بكرة يا شاطر؟ شو رح تعمل ساعتها؟ أجي أكسر الفرع عندكم؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: سيدي الفاضل، أنا معك وبتابع الموضوع شخصياً، وبعطيك رقم مرجعي للشكوى إذا حابب تتأكد، ورقم المرجعي هو ٩٨٧٦.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب هات الرقم، وسجل عندك، لو ما رجعوا المصاري بكرة الصبح، راح أشتكي عليكم لحماية المستهلك وألغي كل خطوطي عندكم!

segments.speaker: Agent

segments.speaker: Customer

segments.text: Sounds great. Thank you again, and have a wonderful rest of your day.

segments.text: Thank you for calling Metro Utilities, and you have a wonderful day as well!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Metro Utilities, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

segments.text: Finally, someone picked up. I have been on hold for twenty minutes, and I am furious. I want my money back right now.

segments.text: I am very sorry about the long wait time, and I understand you are upset. I would be happy to help you with a refund. Can I please have your account number and the phone number associated with it?

segments.text: My account number is 449281039 and you already have my phone number. More importantly, you charged my credit card for a service installation order that I cancelled two weeks ago!

segments.text: Thank you for providing that, Mr. Davis. Let me pull up your account and look into this cancellation and the corresponding charge.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: You better look into it quickly. I cancelled that order within the allowed window, yet you still billed me two hundred and fifty dollars. This is outright theft.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I completely understand your frustration regarding an unexpected charge. I am looking at your account history right now... Okay, I do see the cancellation request submitted on the twelfth.

segments.text: Exactly! So why was my card charged on the eighteenth? Are your systems completely incompetent, or is this deliberate?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I sincerely apologize for the error. It looks like the cancellation ticket was processed, but the billing hold wasn't released before the automated billing cycle ran.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can certainly process that refund of two hundred and fifty dollars for you today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: "I can certainly process that" - yeah, you damn well better! But just processing it isn't enough. Why did it happen in the first place, and why do I have to fight to get my own money back?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I understand your anger, and I take full responsibility for the oversight on our end. The refund has been initiated, but please allow three to five business days for it to appear on your statement.

segments.text: Three to five business days? No, unacceptable! You took my money instantly, so you need to put it back instantly. I want an expedited transfer right now.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I wish I could force an instant transfer, Mr. Davis, but our banking merchant processor requires three to five business days for electronic refunds to clear back to a credit card.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That is a cop-out! I want to speak to your supervisor immediately. I am not accepting this garbage excuse.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can certainly transfer you to a supervisor, but please be aware that the queue for a supervisor callback is currently about fifteen minutes due to high volume.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fifteen minutes? Unbelievable! You people are completely useless. Put me through right now, and they better be able to give me my money today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I am transferring you to a supervisor now, Mr. Davis. Please stay on the line and the next available manager will assist you.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Just transfer me. And you better note my file that I am reporting this company to the Better Business Bureau.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Your feedback has been noted in the system, and the supervisor will have all the details. Connecting you now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: ماشي يا رامي، شكلك فهمت عليّ. بس بدي التأكيد يوصلني حالا مش بكره، ويعطيكم العافية.

segments.speaker: Agent

segments.text: Thank you for calling SwiftCom Customer Support, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

segments.text: Hi, yes, I'm calling about a package I was supposed to get, but it's not here.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can certainly help you look into that shipment for you. May I have your account number or the tracking number, please?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh, let me find it. Wait, did you say account number or tracking number? Sorry, my hearing isn't great.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No problem at all. Either one works. If you have the tracking number handy, that would be great.

segments.text: Okay, let me read it to you. It is TRK-9942-X. Wait, was that too fast? Do you need me to repeat it?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I got the first part, TRK-9942, but could you repeat the last letter and any numbers after it?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure, it is X as in xylophone, then 71. So, TRK-9942-X71.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect, I have that entered now. Let me pull up the delivery details for this router shipment.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Wait, what did you say? Did you say something about a router?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, this tracking number is for your new Wi-Fi gateway router and extender kit.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh! I thought this was about my new phone. Wait, is the phone coming in a different box?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: The phone was actually shipped in a separate package last week. Did you receive that one yet?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: You're going to have to speak up, my phone is cutting out a little bit. Did you say something about last week?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, I said the phone shipped last week. Did that one arrive?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh, the phone? Yes, that came on Tuesday. But this router thing, what day is it supposed to get here?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: According to the system, it was actually out for delivery three days ago, but the status shows a delay due to a weather incident in your area.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Wait, what? Is it lost? Who had an incident?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: It's not lost, ma'am. There was a severe storm in your region earlier in the week, which delayed the delivery truck by a few days.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: A storm? But the sun was out on Tuesday. Are you sure it's coming here?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, the storm was on Monday night, which created a backlog at the local sorting facility. But the carrier update shows it is rescheduled for delivery tomorrow afternoon.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Tomorrow afternoon? Let me write that down. What time tomorrow?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: It should be delivered by 4:00 PM tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, 4:00 AM? Did you say 4:00 AM?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No, 4:00 PM in the afternoon.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh, PM! Okay, got it. And do I need to be home to sign for it?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No signature is required, so they will just leave it on your porch or in your mailbox.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Is there anything else I need to do, or just wait?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Just wait for it to arrive tomorrow. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, I think that covers it. Thank you for clearing that up, Marcus.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're very welcome. Have a wonderful rest of your day and stay safe!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling SwiftConnect Technical Support, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

segments.text: Hi, yes, I just got this new Wi-Fi extender in the mail and I am completely lost on how to plug it in and make it work.

segments.text: I can certainly help you with the setup process today. Do you have the extender out of the box and ready?

segments.text: لا تقلق أبداً سيدي، أنا راح أكتب note واضحة بكل التفاصيل، والفرق اللي انحسب زيادة راح يرجعلك كـ credit بالفاتورة الجاية.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: ممتاز كثير، قديش رح يأخذ وقت لحتى ينزل الـ adjustment؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: عادةً بياخذ من ثلاث لخميس أيام عمل، ورح تصلك رسالة تأكيد على رقمك أول ما ينتهي الموضوع.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: تمام، مشكور كتير على تعبكم وحسن تعاونكم معي اليوم.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: العفو سيدي، هذا واجبنا، هل في أي شي تاني بقدر أساعدك فيه اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: لا تسلم، كل شي واضح، يعطيك العافية.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: الله يعافيك، شكرا لاتصالك بشركة الاتصالات، ويومك سعيد.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Metro Utilities, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I am calling because my power is about to be shut off today, and this is completely ridiculous! I need an extension right now!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I understand you are concerned about your service, and I'd be happy to check your account for extension options. May I have your account number and name, please?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It's 45892130, Robert Davis. And don't just tell me no, because I've been a customer for ten years and I've never missed a payment until this month!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Davis. I see your current balance of two hundred and forty dollars was due last week. Let me look at your eligibility for a payment extension.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I don't need you to look, I need you to grant it! I get paid next Friday, and I am not sitting in the dark with my kids because of a few days!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I do show that an extension was already granted on this account last quarter, which unfortunately prevents the system from automatically applying another one.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Are you kidding me? You're going to shut off my electricity over a policy when I'm telling you I can pay next week? Let me talk to your manager immediately!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can certainly transfer you to a supervisor to discuss further options, Mr. Davis. Please hold while I connect you.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Ahlan sidi, welcome to FiberNet support, my name is Fadi, kif b2dar aosadak?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Ahlan ya Fadi, shukran. Wallah I am calling today bas to file a formal complaint about an agent I spoke with earlier today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Oh, I am so sorry to hear that, inshallah khair, what happened exactly?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Ya akhi, the agent was extremely rude and unhelpful, w ma samahni ašraħlo el mushkile at all.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Astaghfirullah, I apologize deeply for this behavior, sadiqi, this is definitely not the standard we expect here.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Shukran for understanding, wallah I was very polite, bas he just raised his voice w hang up on me.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: That is completely unacceptable, wallah, let me take your account number please so I can log this feedback and take care of your issue right now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure, el raqm howa 0795543210, shukran jazeelan for your professional help, Fadi.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Afwan sidi, w wallah I will make sure el manager yšof el complaint, and let's fix your original issue right away.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: مرحباً معك أحمد، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: أهلاً أحمد، لو سمحت أنا اشتريت الراوتر الجديد بس مش عم ببط زابط معي الـ setup بالبيت.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، ولا تحاتي، خلينا نمشي خطوة بخطوة. إنت شبكت الـ power cable مظبوط؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: إيه نعم، وصلته بالكهرباء والـ lights كلهم شغلتين، بس مش عارف كيف أعمل connection مع الـ Wi-Fi.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: تمام ممتاز. فتحت اللابتوب أو الموبايل ودورت على الـ network name اللي موجودة على الاستيكر من تحت؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: دورَت عليها، ولقيتها وكتبت الـ password بس بقلي "no internet connection".

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أكيد، طبيعي جداً بالبداية هيك يصير. طيب خبرني، سلك التلفون أو الفايبر واصل بالـ port الأزرق بالخلف؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: لحظة شوي خليني أتأكد.. أه سيدي، واصل بالفتحة الزرقاء المظبوطة.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: رائع جداً. طيب جربت تعمل restart للراوتر من الزر الصغير اللي ورا؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: لسه والله، خليني أجرب أكيد. أوه، هيني طفيته ورجعت شعلته، استنى شوي لنشوف الـ lights شو رح يعطونا.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: خذ وقتك سيدي، أنا معك على الخط عم بستنى أشوف إذا الـ internet light صارت ثابتة.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: اه والله يا أحمد، الضوء صار أخضر وثابت! خليني أجرب أفتح صفحة على الموبايل.. أوه ماشاء الله، كل شي صار شغال تمام والنت سريع!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: الحمد لله سيدي، كتير مبسوط إني قدرت أساعدك اليوم. في أي إشي تاني بقدر أخدمك فيه؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: سلامتك والله، مشكور جداً على تعبك معي ووقتك.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: العفو، أهلاً وسهلاً فيك، ويوم سعيد يا رب!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: مرحبا سيدي، معك محمد من خدمة العملاء كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: يا أخي أنا بدي أعمل cancellation للحساب تاعي، زهقت من الـ charges اللي بتطلعلي كل شهر بدون سبب.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، أنا فاهم عليّك تماماً، بس ممكن تعطيني الـ account number لو سمحت عشان أشوف شو القصة؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: تفضل، الرقم هو 48921. وبصراحة بدي إياه يتقفل اليوم، ما عندي خلق لأي delays.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: تمام يا سيدي، شيكت على السيستم ولقيت إن في extra fees نزلت بالخطأ، وهلا عملت لها waive وفضيت الحساب نهائياً.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: آه والله؟ يعني خلص انحلت المشكلة وما رح ينزل عليّ إشي تاني؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: أكيد سيدي، تم إغلاق الحساب بنجاح وما في أي مبالغ مترتبة عليك أبداً.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: ممتاز جداً، شكراً كتير لمساعدتك السريعة ويعطيك العافية.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: عافاك سيدي، وشكراً لاتصالك معنا، يوماً سعيداً!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Peak Telecom, my name is Marcus. How can I assist you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Finally, someone answers. Look, I am calling because I am absolutely furious about the way I was treated by one of your representatives about twenty minutes ago.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I am very sorry to hear that you had a negative experience. Can you please tell me what happened?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: What happened is your agent was completely rude, condescending, and outright disrespectful to me just because I asked a simple question about my bill.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I sincerely apologize for that behavior. That is definitely not the standard of service we expect our team to provide. Do you happen to remember the name of the representative you spoke with?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: He said his name was Kevin, or at least that's what he mumbled before he basically yelled over me and then hung up the phone in my ear!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: He disconnected the call while you were still speaking?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes! Exactly! I was trying to explain why the data charge shouldn't be on my account, and he scoffed at me, told me I wasn't listening, and just clicked the line dead. I am appalled.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I am so sorry, that is completely unacceptable customer service, and I completely understand why you are upset.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good, because I've been with this company for eight years, and I have never, ever been treated with such disrespect. I want to speak to a supervisor immediately.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I completely understand your frustration, and I can certainly get a supervisor on the line for you if you'd like. However, before I do that, I would love the opportunity to look at your bill myself and resolve the actual issue you called about.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Look, at this point, I don't even care about the bill as much as I care about that employee's attitude. People like that shouldn't be working in customer support.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You are entirely right, and I am documenting this interaction right now to report it directly to management for review and coaching.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Make sure you note my account number. It's 44892011. And I want to make sure there's an official complaint logged against Kevin.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: It is noted, and I have flagged your account with a formal complaint regarding that call. It will be reviewed by the customer relations manager today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fine. I appreciate you actually listening to me, unlike the last guy. Now, can we actually look at this $40 data overage charge? Because I was out of the country, but I had my data roaming turned off the entire time.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I would be more than happy to look into that for you right now. Let me pull up your usage logs for last month.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thank you. It's just frustrating that I had to go through all of this anger just to get basic help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I completely agree, and I am taking personal ownership of your account right now to make sure this gets sorted out properly. Let's see what we can do about waiving that charge for you today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: مرحبا معك رامي من شركة الاتصالات كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: يا أخي شوفلي حل اليوم أنا طال صبركم صراحة، فاتورتي نازلة عالية كثير والمصيبة مسكرين الخدمة عن النت فجأة بدون إنذار!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ولا يهمك يا سيدي، فهمني المشكلة بالضبط لنحلها سوا. كم رقم الحساب لو سمحت؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: الرقم هو ثمانية سبعة ستة خمسة، اسمعني كويس، أنا زلمة حالتي المادية هالشهر صعبة وما عندي أدفع المبلغ كامل اليوم، وبدي مهلة للدفع لآخر الشهر.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: بصير خير إن شاء الله، خليني أتأكد من تفاصيل الحساب بس... نعم الحساب مستحق عليه خمسين دينار والموعد كان مبارح.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: ما أنا بقلك عارف إنه فات موعده، بس ليش بتقطعوا النت دغري؟ الواحد لازم يتنفس مش هيك المعاملة!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: معك حق وباعتذر عن الإزعاج اللي صار، بس النظام أوتوماتيك بفصل لما تتجاوز الفاتورة موعدها. بالنسبة لطلب تمديد الدفع، بقدر أعطيك مهلة لحد تاريخ خمسة وعشرين الشهر.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: طيب ممتاز، بتقدر ترجع تفعل النت هسا ولا لازم أدفع جزء منه أول؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: يلا عجل شوي الله يرضى عليك، بدي النت يرجع يشتغل ضروري لإنو عندي شغل عاللابتوب!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: ثواني بس أتأكد من السياسة... نعم سيدي، لازم تدفع عشرين دينار مبدئياً كدفعة حسن نية وبتسجل المهلة تلقائي.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: يوه! يعني ما في مهلة هيك لله بدون ما أدفع هسا؟ طيب يلا هسا بدخل عالأبليكيشن وبدفع العشرين، بس رجع النت بسرعة فاهم علي؟

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: تمام يا سيدي، جاري إرسال طلب إعادة التوصيل وخلال دقايق بكون عندك النت شغال، في شي ثاني بقدر أخدمك فيه؟

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: لا سلامتك، بس يا ريت تفعلوا الخدمة بسرعة، شكراً إلك.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: العفو، يوم سعيد وشكراً لاتصالك بشركة الاتصالات.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Ahlan wa sahlan, welcome to Apex Telecom, my name is Rami, kif bage’dek yom?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Ahlan Rami, wallah I’m doing well thanks. I actually called because I want to close my internet and landline account.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that you want to disconnect,momken a’ref the reason for closing? Is there a problem with the service wla shi?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, msh meshkleh b el-service at all, wallah your speeds were great. Bas I’m relocating abroad next week, so khalas ma badoor el-line hōn.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Tahrīf salameh inshallah, trōh w terga' belsalameh! Akid, we can process the cancellation for you, bas I just need to verify some details meshshān security.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure, akid, tfdal. What do you need?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Momken your full name w el-account number iza betred?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: My name is Tariq Al-Hashemi, and el-account number is 8849201.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Shokran ya ostaz Tariq. Let me check the system... okay, I see the profile here. Now, bikhsoos el-final bill, akid enta بتعرف enno there's a small prorated amount for this month, right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Aywa, I expected that. Kif rah ašfha? Will you send it to my email?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Na’am, exactly, it will be emailed to your registered address. Bas let me just check if you have any remaining contract commitment wla خلص.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I’m pretty sure el-contract خلص months ago, bas please double check la enno I don't want any delay.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, exactly as you said, el-commitment khalas ended last month, so there are zero termination fees, bas just the current month usage.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mumtaz, that’s great news. Shu el-khatwa el-jayeh? What do I need to do with the router?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: The router, meshshān el-device, you can drop it off at any of our branches before you travel, aw momken we send a courier to pick it up, bas el-branch is faster.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I think I can pass by el-branch el-yom el-masa, which branch is open late?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: El-branch el-ra’isi on King Abdullah Street is open till 10 PM, so you can go anytime.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, I’ll drop it there today. So el-account will be closed today wallah ba’den?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Once I submit the request now, it will be scheduled for closure effective end of day today, w el-final invoice will be generated in 48 hours.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Awesome, thank you so much Rami for your help and excellent service.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Afwan ya ostaz Tariq, we are always happy to help, w teroh w terga’ belsalameh ya rab! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: La shokran, that’s everything. Have a great day!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you, bye bye.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Hello, welcome to Zain customer care, معاك محمد. How can I help you today, akhi?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Ah, hi Mohammed. Ya akhi, I just want to check, min sabaah el-yom my home internet is completely down. Is there a general outage wala meshkileh with my router bas?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Let me check the system real quick. What is your account number or phone number, please?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Shukran. Let's see here... Ah, yes, actually we have a major outage fi mantiqet el-Jubeiha right now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Aah, mantiqet el-Jubeiha kolha? Bas kaman my neighbors are complaining. So it's from your side mesh men andi?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Exactly, yes, it's a fiber cut mneshruo el-amanah, so our technicians are already on site working on it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Inshallah mesh kbeer? How long usually beta5od to be back online?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: The estimated time of repair, bas according to the field team, it will take around two to three hours maximum.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, no worries. Bas iza bitrdf, can you add temporary data 3al mobile tabaei till it's fixed?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, absolute! I can add 5GB free data bundle to your mobile number as compensation for the inconvenience.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's very kind of you, shukran jazeelan. Will it be activated immediately?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, it will be active within five minutes, wel-resala hateesalak 3al phone.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, I appreciate your help Mohammed. Have a good day.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: My pleasure, ya hala feek, and sorry for the delay. Have a great day!
